brief: Prioritise Sandbourne Ridge 230/34kV for pre-event attention because it is an ageing unit with a history of high loading and prior heat-related faults, giving it a reduced margin against mechanical failure ([MG-023]). Since the unit cannot be attended before the event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure ([MG-023]). Ensure every de-rating applied is recorded along with the reason, the value, and the period ([MG-021]).
